spoilers.text: #ONEPIECE1190 Shanks: "Take this strawhat, it's dear to me" Rayleigh: "Rise to the very top!" Gaban: Video The Will of Marco (マルコの意志) (@TheWillOfMarco) #ONEPIECE1190 GABAN GIVES LUFFY A HARSH AND BRUTAL SCOLDING 🗣️🔥🔥🔥 --------------------------- Before blocking Imu's attack on Luffy, it seems that Gaban slashed the tree where Luffy was pinned into several sections. As the tree sections falls, the two swords impaling Luffy came loose. Gaban sees Imu for the first time, and the two begin to converse. Gaban to Imu: What a dreadful appearance... It doesn't even look like something from this world...!! Imu: Who art thou? Gaban: A person who knows of the world... Luffy: AAAHHHHHH!!! Gaban: Hey... *Gaban picks Luffy up by the scruff and holds him up* Gaban: Get up, Straw Hat Luffy... Luffy: UWAAAHHHHH!!! OWWOWWOWWWWWWW!!! Gaban: I'm disappointed in you...!! Getting saved by an injured old geezer like me... Don't you feel ashamed...?! "White form" ?! "Yonko" ?! Luffy: Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow!!! Gaban: Don't get full of yourself!!! Luffy: Owwww!!! Old mban!!! Ledd go ovv mbe!!! Gaban: Do you plan to die here!? Luffy: I... I'mb dot godda die!! Ow-ow-ow, led me go... Gaban: No, you were basically dead!! Pathetic!! If you die, what do you think will happen?! Luffy: I won't be able... to protect my friend's country...!!! Gaban: That's right!! What will happen to your crew that you brought all the way here?! Luffy: Their lives... would be at risk...!! Huff... Gaban: That's right... listen, in this sea... the higher you climb, the more enemies you gain! The "Pirate King" is a title given to someone whose death is rejoiced*!! Because everybody wants to sit in that throne!!! (This is the reference to the chapter title: "One Whose Death Is Rejoiced") Luffy: Agh... Ugh... Gaban: If you think you can become the "Pirate King" peacefully, cheerfully, and merrily, go back to your hometown!! Luffy: Damn it...!!! Gaban: You're not built for this!! *Gaban throws Luffy away* Luffy: Waahhh!!! Gaban: You'll just get in my way, you shitty brat!! Luffy: Owwwww!! Ugh...!! *Luffy fells face down on the ground* Luffy: Damn it!! That old geezer!! Saying just whatever he wants!! Just you wait...!! — https://nitter.net/TheWillOfMarco/status/2085236689560322410#m

misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 Many people don't understand this panel, but Gaban is using a Haki beam (Haki lightning bolt). No, Gaban isn't using an air slash or an axe attack; he jumps and charges up his Haki and unleashes it through his movement. There are several signs indicating that it is a pure Haki lightning bolt: The trees are severed exactly where a lightning bolt had struck; we see three cuts, precisely in the same direction where a tree was split. But that isn't the main argument, look at Imu. He has an Omen barrier, and it blocks... a Haki lightning bolt!(the middle red circle) There is no sign of an air slash(He use a air slash attack in the next attack, not with Divine Gate); on the contrary, look behind Imu: when he deflects the lightning bolt, it cuts through the area behind him upon impact with the tree.(blue circle). There is no indication of an air slash in that panel(in fact we see his air slash move right in the next panel as a new attack, not Divine Gate), it was pure Haki lightning that severed the tree( we literally see the lightning hitting Imu Omen barrier). Gaban leaps up, charges his full Haki, and unleashes it as an attack through his movement; we have only seen Haki used in this form before with Shanks's "Wifi Haki." This means Gaban essentially used the Haki lightning as a beam attack; it even broke through Imu's Omen defense and injured him, despite the block.

misc.title: A small correction: yes, Gaban uses his axe, but not in the classic sense (which is what I actually meant by "axe attack"): He uses it as a medium to charge up his Haki and hurl it at his opponent in
misc.text: A small correction: yes, Gaban uses his axe, but not in the classic sense (which is what I actually meant by "axe attack"): He uses it as a medium to charge up his Haki and hurl it at his opponent in a single motion. Shanks did the same thing in *Pirate Warriors*: he charged his Haki into his sword and then unleashed it fully, much like a thunderbolt.
